meta.title: The b_share normalization defect: the absolute 0.50 bars have been reading a series that essentially never clears 0.50
meta.merge_rule: STRICTLY ADDITIVE. Two plays gain an amendment key. No existing key is rewritten. Six plays gain an explicit DO-NOT-MOVE note so the fix is not over-applied.
meta.code_already_landed: flow_read.py now serves *_two_sided alongside the originals plus unsided_volume_frac; forecast_harness copies them through to tape_conditions. G21/G22 restaged, PASS, verified strictly additive (recursive strip: all pre-existing fields byte-identical).

what_is_PROVEN_vs_what_is_NOT.proven: The normalization defect, its magnitude, and its effect on any absolute 0.50 bar. All measured on the 223 sessions on disk.
what_is_PROVEN_vs_what_is_NOT.not_proven: That this defect is the WHOLE of the blind's -206 USD/day flat down bias. It is the leading candidate with a mechanism and a timeline fit, not a demonstrated cause.
what_is_PROVEN_vs_what_is_NOT.the_test: G21 is the forward test. It is the first blind to run with the two-sided series available.

the_measurement.the_defect: Every *_b_share divides by TOTAL volume. The tape carries a third side value ('N', neither B nor A). Unsided volume lands in the DENOMINATOR and can never land in the numerator, so every b_share is biased LOW.
the_measurement.why_0.4999_is_the_tell: Two-sided aggressor balance over 223 sessions comes out at 0.4999 - dead on the 50/50 the physics requires, since every trade has a buyer and a seller. The served series averaging 0.4078 is therefore a measurement artifact, not a market feature.

it_is_NOT_a_constant_shift.consequence: The served series retains only ~28% of the true series' variance. It is a NOISY downward-biased proxy, not a shifted coordinate - so it cannot be corrected by moving a bar down.

the_measurement.worked_example: G22 20260622: served b_share 0.357 (strongly sell-leaning) against a true two-sided 0.549 (buy-leaning), on 34.9% unsided volume. A sign flip across 0.50 on one session.
the_measurement.what_is_NOT_affected: session_signed_flow is CLEAN: (sd*sz).sum() with sd in {-1,0,+1} gives unsided trades zero weight and has no denominator. The blind's signed-flow channel was always correct - which is why the defect survived this long.

value.assumed: That the arm-(b) bar 'session_b_share >= 0.50' means 'more buying than selling'.
value.measured: On the served series that bar clears on 5 of 223 sessions (2.2%). On the two-sided series it clears on 107 of 223 (48.0%). The two disagree about which side of 0.50 a session sits on 45.7% of the time.
value.now_licensed: Arm (b) must read session_b_share_two_sided. The bar stays 0.50 - it was never the bar that was wrong, it was the series.
value.why_this_play_matters_most: It is a SELECTOR on bimodal splits - the machinery that decides which angle wins when the read is two-sided. An arm that is structurally unreachable on ~98% of sessions does not merely mis-fire; it removes one side of the selection from the walk. C measured the symptom on G20 (sub-0.50 on 10 of 10 sessions, so the up angle was excluded BY CONSTRUCTION in a block that rallied +1,860) without identifying the cause.
value.timeline_fit_CIRCUMSTANTIAL_not_proof: This play entered at s102.3, after G16. G17 was a DOWN block (actual cum -1,070) and the drift was only -970. G18, G19 and G20 were UP blocks (+610, +1,150, +1,860) and the drift ran -2,330 / -2,370 / -2,560. A structurally down-gated selector costs little in a falling block and progressively more in a rising one. That fits the observed pattern but does not establish it.
value.proposed_by: session lead (S108), from C's G20 symptom

value.assumed: Same absolute 0.50 b_share bar, same meaning.
value.measured: Same measurement as above - the bar clears on 2.2% of sessions as served.

explicit_DO_NOT_MOVE_these.principle: A bar FITTED EMPIRICALLY on the served series was fitted where it is used, and silently re-normalizing underneath it would break it. Only THEORETICALLY-motivated bars - where 0.50 is meant to mean 'balance' - move. This distinction is the whole reason the code fix is additive rather than a replacement.
explicit_DO_NOT_MOVE_these.the_caveat_that_should_not_be_lost: These bars are internally consistent but they were fitted on a proxy correlating 0.532 with the real quantity. They are not wrong; they are WEAK - a bar fitted on a half-informative proxy cannot separate as well as one fitted on the real series. RE-FITTING them on the two-sided series is a measurement study worth doing, and it is NOT part of this proposal. Do not re-fit by eye.
explicit_DO_NOT_MOVE_these.flow.big_print_bshare_thin_tape_guard_no: Its thin-tape finding (dispersion doubles below ~20 big prints) is a SAMPLE-SIZE effect and survives the re-normalization untouched. Only its absolute bar levels are basis-dependent.

forward_test_G21.why_G21_is_the_test: It is the first blind to run with the two-sided series available, and it is already the first group with the full kitchen sink intact (storage + vol_regime + weather + size-weighted big_print_b_share + the Monday prior_full_session fix).
forward_test_G21.prediction: If this defect is a material part of the flat down bias, G21's blind block cum should not sit structurally below the actual the way G18/G19/G20 did (-1,720/-1,220/-700 against +610/+1,150/+1,860).
forward_test_G21.falsifier: If G21's blind lean is unchanged in sign and comparable in size, the b_share normalization is NOT a material driver of the lean, and it should be recorded as a real defect that was nonetheless not the cause - the -206/day bias then lies elsewhere.
forward_test_G21.attribution_warning: G21 changes several inputs at once. When it is scored, the post-mortem must say which change earned which improvement, or the merge banks a data fix as evidence for a play. This is exactly the discipline the G20 merge applied to weather, which earned nothing on any day.

adjudication_checklist: 2 amendments, both ADD a new key. Verify all pre-existing keys on all 66 incumbents byte-identical.
6 plays explicitly listed as DO-NOT-MOVE, recorded in the proposal rather than edited, so the fix is not over-applied later.
The code fix is already landed and verified additive; this proposal only re-points two theoretically-motivated bars.
The lean claim is stated as a CANDIDATE with a named falsifier, not as a demonstrated cause.
